messages.content: You are an expert in generating Selenium Python page object classes using provided DOM information. Use Selenium WebDriver Python conventions with proper By locators, and insert TODO comments only when a mapping is missing. Make sure every page method includes docstrings in the generated code. Generate only code grounded in the supplied DOM.

Given the following DOM structure:
```html
===HTML===

<input class="inputLogin" type="text" id="username" name="USERNAME" size="50">
<input class="inputLogin" type="password" id="password" name="PASSWORD" size="50">
<input class="decorativeSubmit" type="submit" value="Login">
```
Generate a Selenium Python page object class for this DOM.

from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.remote.webdriver import WebDriver


class GeneratedPage:
    """Page Object for the Generated page."""

    USERNAME_INPUT = (By.ID, "username")
    PASSWORD_INPUT = (By.ID, "password")
    LOGIN_BUTTON = (By.CSS_SELECTOR, "input[type="submit"]")

    def __init__(self, driver: WebDriver) -> None:
        self.driver = driver

    def enter_username(self, username: str) -> None:
        """Enter username into the field."""
        self.driver.find_element(*self.USERNAME_INPUT).send_keys(username)

    def enter_password(self, password: str) -> None:
        """Enter password into the field."""
        self.driver.find_element(*self.PASSWORD_INPUT).send_keys(password)

    def click_login(self) -> None:
        """Click the Login."""
        self.driver.find_element(*self.LOGIN_BUTTON).click()
